description: An offline AI-powered desk companion robot unit that translates natural language commands using a local LLM into motor movements and eye/face animations on an ESP32 via WebSockets, with dedicated AP-mode UDP camera streaming from an ESP32-CAM.

audio.service.py: AudioService class managing Chatterbox-Nano primary speech synthesis with pre-cached custom cloned reference voice (ikru_voice.wav), phonetic word normalization for 'Ikru', paralinguistic tag preservation, 44.1kHz 16-bit stereo WAV resampling, local background HTTP streaming on port 8000, and Edge-TTS fallback.

chat.engine.py: ChatEngine class managing Ollama LLM conversation history and querying.
chat.prompts.py: System prompt, robot identity with strict 'Ikru' name capitalization rule, natural voice expressive paralinguistic sound tags ([chuckle], [laugh], [sigh], [gasp], [clear throat]), OLED emotion rules, and movement tool instructions.
chat.parser.py: Extracts OLED facial expression [emotion] tags while preserving Chatterbox paralinguistic sound tags inside spoken text chunks, and parses tool calls from LLM JSON responses.

vision.receiver.py: VisionReceiver class handling AP discovery handshake (port 2223) and reassembling 22-byte header UDP packets into frames (port 2222).
vision.frame_buffer.py: Thread-safe latest-frame buffer with zero queue buildup.
vision.vlm.py: VLMClient for on-demand visual reasoning with Qwen3-VL/LLaVA.

mic.controller.py: MicController class handling PyAudio/SpeechRecognition initialization, ambient noise calibration, and Google Speech-to-Text.

robot.controller.py: RobotController WebSocket client managing connection to ws://{ip}:81 with keep-alive pings, background auto-reconnect, motor movements, full-screen OLED animated eye expressions (with speech text box removed), and I2S audio playback (SPEAK_URL / STOP_AUDIO) synchronized with emotion duration.
robot.protocol.py: Command strings, constants, and scroll timing calculations.

packages.main.py: Main CLI loop integrating ChatEngine, RobotController, VisionReceiver, MicController, and AudioService.

controller.purpose: ESP32 Body & OLED firmware managing WebSocket server (port 81), MAX98357A I2S natural voice streaming on Core 0, DRV8833 dual motors (remapped to GPIO 18/19), and full-screen eye animations with blinking, emotion transitions, and eye tracking without speech text box overlay.

head.purpose: ESP32-CAM Head Unit ('IKRU-CAM' / 192.168.4.1) firmware streaming UDP video on port 2222 with discovery on port 2223 and configurable OV2640 orientation controls (CAMERA_VFLIP/CAMERA_HMIRROR).

audio.esp32_test_receiver.ino: Standalone ESP32 I2S WAV streaming firmware (MAX98357A on GPIO 25/26/27, 44.1kHz stereo 16-bit).
audio.test_audio_server.py: Local HTTP audio server (port 8000) with edge-tts speech synthesis and 44.1kHz stereo WAV resampling.
audio.test_tts_comparison.py: Interactive TTS expressiveness and accent comparison suite evaluating Chatterbox-Nano (paralinguistic tags like [chuckle], [laugh], [sigh], [gasp]) and Edge-TTS regional accents (US, UK, Australian, Indian) with local PC playback and optional streaming to the ESP32 robot speaker.

vision.test_udp_receiver.py: Standalone UDP test receiver with MobileNet-SSD object detection.

mic.test_mic_stt.py: Microphone enumeration, PyAudio hardware test, and Google Web Speech API speech-to-text trial.
